prep.summary: You must navigate critical platform decisions and capacity constraints—specifically transitioning the Scan AI RFP technical ownership and addressing the shadow architecture misperceptions raised by RV. To balance the heavy workload, you need to shift low-level design tasks to the engineering bench—shielding architects from reactive tasks so they can focus on high-level governance. Recent updates demand immediate alignment with RV on the Intelligent Business Automation Platform—leveraging structured slides to clarify Scan AI's status and the 90-day pod consulting model.
tasks: Transfer technical ownership of the Scan AI RFP to the platform infrastructure team.
Establish the time-boxed consulting model for the 90-day execution pods to protect resource capacity.
Redirect low-level design tasks and domain queries to the engineering bench.
Present the revised Intelligent Business Automation Platform matrix to RV to clarify tool capabilities.

prep.summary: You must navigate the transition of the D&S Partners meeting to a bi-weekly cadence—incorporating Canon and Kunjin to prevent alignment surprises—while driving the Billing Virtual Agent toward its October 2026 internal go-live. Regarding your August 3 discussion with Jonathan on ChatGPT, you must resolve the infrastructure bottleneck—specifically whether to deploy a tactical AWS-hosted MCP endpoint immediately or wait for the centralized enterprise gateway. This decision requires you to escalate key governance compromises directly to Suresh, Yanka, and Enterprise Security for formal sign-off.
tasks: Resolve the MCP endpoint bottleneck by deciding between tactical AWS hosting or waiting for the centralized enterprise gateway.
Escalate ChatGPT governance compromises to Suresh, Yanka, and Enterprise Security to secure formal policy waivers.
Engage Canon and Kunjin in the upcoming D&S Partners bi-weekly syncs to maintain capability alignment.
Audit the parallel Agent Assist tracks—both Matt's build models and Casey's buy options—to prepare for the August evolutionary demo.

You analyzed competitive pressures from players like Liberty Mutual and proposed bypassing institutional bottlenecks—relying instead on autonomous tiger teams. The discussion concluded with a focus on shifting leadership incentives and deploying a rapid, AI-driven quoting pilot.
tasks: Finalize the competitive analysis presentation snippet for the Suhas management meeting.
Review leadership incentives to align performance metrics with corporate AI adoption goals.
Launch a low-risk, agentic quoting capability pilot to bypass traditional development bottlenecks.
Draft talking points regarding proposed structural changes to the current technology operating model.
